画面和真实大小、时间不成比例。: Sizes and times in the picture are not to scale.
换个条件，再看一次: Change a condition and look again
从地面的水，到云里的小水滴，再回到河流和大海。: From surface water to tiny cloud droplets, then back to rivers and the sea.
水没有消失，它在换地方。: Water has not vanished. It is moving from place to place.
水循环没有唯一的起点，也不是每滴水都按同一条路线走。蒸发不需要把水煮开；空气中的: The water cycle has no single starting point, and drops take many different routes. Evaporation does not require boiling; water vapor itself is invisible. Clouds contain droplets or ice crystals; this page illustrates a warm-cloud rain pathway.
虚线和发亮的小点用来追踪水的旅行，不是水蒸气真实的可见外观。热量按钮只定性改变蒸: Dashed lines and glowing dots trace water movement; they do not depict visible water vapor. The heat control qualitatively changes evaporation cues. A little extra warmth does not guarantee rain.
太阳给地面和水面带来能量。一些水变成看不见的水蒸气，进入空气。: The Sun supplies energy to land and water. Some liquid water becomes invisible water vapor in the air.
含水蒸气的空气冷却时，水蒸气可能在微小颗粒上凝结成小水滴。很多小水滴聚在一起，我: As moist air cools, water vapor can condense on tiny particles to form droplets. Many tiny droplets together make a visible cloud.
云里的小水滴可以碰到一起、长得更大。当向上的气流托不住它们时，雨滴就落下来了。: Cloud droplets can join and grow larger. When the rising air can no longer keep them aloft, raindrops fall.
雨水有的沿地面流进小河，有的渗进土里。河流把一部分水送回海洋，水的旅行还会继续。: Some rain runs into streams, and some soaks into the ground. Rivers return some water to the ocean. The journey continues.
